# Pergola Building Permit

> Pergola Building Permit (part of GetMyPermit) prepares and lodges building permit applications for pergolas, patios, verandahs and decks in Perth and Western Australia.

## Pages

- [Pergola building permits in Perth, done for you.](https://pergolabuildingpermit.com.au/): Need a pergola or patio building permit in Perth or WA? We check your council's rules, prepare the plans and engineering, and lodge it for you. Fixed price.
- [Do I need council approval for a pergola in WA?](https://pergolabuildingpermit.com.au/do-i-need-council-approval-for-a-pergola): When a pergola needs a building permit in WA: roofed or open, attached or freestanding, plus the 10 m² rule and the planning rules that still apply.
- [Patio building permits in WA](https://pergolabuildingpermit.com.au/patio-building-permit): Attached patios and verandahs need a building permit in WA. What's needed, the boundary rules, enclosing a patio, and how we prepare and lodge it for you.
- [Deck building permits in WA](https://pergolabuildingpermit.com.au/deck-building-permit): Most decks in WA need a building permit, especially raised and attached decks. Privacy rules, balustrades, decks near pools, and how we handle the application.
- [Patio prices in Perth (2026), approvals included](https://pergolabuildingpermit.com.au/patio-prices-perth): Patio prices in Perth for 2026 from local businesses' published figures: flat and gable roof patios per m², patio kits, plus building permit fees, verge bonds and planning.
- [Pergola vs patio: the real difference](https://pergolabuildingpermit.com.au/pergola-vs-patio): Pergola vs patio in WA: the legal definitions, why the roof decides it, the 20 m² and 10 m² permit exemptions, attached patios, shade sails and louvre roofs.
- [How to check your patio builder is handling the permit](https://pergolabuildingpermit.com.au/patio-builder-permit-check): Six checks before you sign with a patio builder in WA: permit in the quote, planning approval, written contract, 6.5% deposit limit, home indemnity insurance and registration.
- [City of Wanneroo patio rules](https://pergolabuildingpermit.com.au/city-of-wanneroo-patio-rules): City of Wanneroo patio rules: when you need a building permit, side and front setbacks, posts on the boundary, what to lodge, and the $140 verge bond and $2,200 bond.
- [Do I need approval to put a roof on my pergola?](https://pergolabuildingpermit.com.au/roof-on-pergola-approval): In WA a pergola has no roof by definition. Adding a solid roof makes it a patio, which usually needs a building permit. Shade cloth, louvres, setbacks and engineering explained.
- [Patio approval checker](https://pergolabuildingpermit.com.au/patio-approval-checker): Free patio approval checker for WA. Answer three questions to see if your patio needs a building permit, planning approval or neither, with the size limits explained.
- [Can you enclose a patio without council approval?](https://pergolabuildingpermit.com.au/enclose-a-patio-approval): Enclosing a patio in WA almost always needs a building permit, and often planning approval. Why the rules change once it has walls, the R-Codes traps, and what about blinds.
- [Patio approval cost in Perth (2026)](https://pergolabuildingpermit.com.au/patio-approval-cost-perth): A patio building permit in Perth usually costs about $183 in council fees and levies in 2026-27. Worked examples, BA1 vs BA2, planning fees and the other costs.
- [Guides](https://pergolabuildingpermit.com.au/guides): Free tools and plain-English guides to pergolas, patios and decks approvals in Perth and Western Australia, checked against the official rules.
- [Our prices, upfront](https://pergolabuildingpermit.com.au/pricing): Upfront, fixed prices for pergolas, patios and decks in Perth and WA, with council fees included. Pergola or patio from $990.
